summary: Gated debug HUD renderer: draws a path/name label string and a 41-segment color-coded bar indicator (white vs red on a threshold). Gated by the flt_5EA4E8 telemetry-enable flag; bar block additionally requires the packed flag at dword_8AB6EC and flt_5EA4E8 == 1.0. The ABI lead 'Steering_Ackermann_Computation' (LEGACY) does not match the body, which performs no steering-geometry math.

operations.description: Early-exit guard: if flt_5EA4E8 is not positive (<= 0.0), skip the whole overlay and return 1.
Call ShortComputation_8490 with the address of flt_5EA4E8; the returned double feeds the text positions.
Convert the computed double to int via CRTFtol for the label vertical offset (v9).
Convert the computed double to int via CRTFtol a second time for the bar row offset (v4).
Initialize horizontal cursor v3 to 128.
Load display-name pointer v5 from this[4] (byte offset 0x10); fall back to the default path string byte_5EA438 when null.
If the display-name string v5 differs from the default path string byte_5EA438 (strcmp nonzero), draw the label.
Reload the display-name pointer v6 from this[4] (byte offset 0x10); fall back to byte_5EA438 when null.
Call BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v6, byte_5EC4CC) to test whether the name v6 is present in the string table.
On a table hit, copy the name v6 into byte_5EC4CC via strcpy, or clear byte_5EC4CC to an empty string when v6 is null.
Call sub_587DD0 to copy up to 127 bytes (0x7F) of byte_5EC4CC into the local 127-byte display buffer v12.
Null-terminate the 128-byte stack region by clearing the local byte v13 that follows the 127-byte buffer v12.
Render the label buffer with UITextRenderWithScale at x=100, y=v9, white color 0xFFFFFF, scale 1.0 x 1.0.
Bar-block guard: proceed only if PackedFlagRead_9a00(&dword_8AB6EC) is set and flt_5EA4E8 equals 1.0.
Call sub_4B9A10 on dword_8AB6EC to obtain the threshold value v11 that selects the bar segment color.
Format a single character taken from byte_5D4AEC into v12 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the '%c' format string.
Loop over 41 bar segments (segment index v7 from 0 to 40), advancing horizontal cursor v3 by 25 per segment; v10 tracks the segment index as a double-scaled value.
Render each segment with UITextRenderWithScale at (v3, v4), white 0xFFFFFF when v10 * 0.025 exceeds v11, else red 16711680, scale 1.0 x 1.0.
Return 1 on the early-exit path when the telemetry flag flt_5EA4E8 is not positive.
Return 0 after the label and bar overlay have been rendered.
